entries.description: A message meant for one field. Text is what is said. Field, DataPath and DataKey name the control. Message() posts the text the way the global Message does. A form does not yet draw it beside the control.
entries.parameters: text — the words. field — the control name. dataPath — the attribute path. dataKey — the row, when the field is in a table. All may be omitted.
entries.example:
msg = New UserMessage("Amount is empty", "Amount");
msg.Message();
